in_marathi.name: Sairaj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of the sky
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sairaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sairaj is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sai' which means 'God' and 'Raj' meaning 'ruler'. The name Sairaj is often given to a boy born in the Hindu community, reflecting the belief in the divine protection of the child.
